method: Differential whole-file review against fully read Unix AVX512. Read unified diff1..340 and remaining non-deletion lines; large deletion consists of previously read Unix XOF-many implementation. All Windows added/replaced lines inspected; unchanged lines verified text-identical with SequenceMatcher autojunk disabled. No independent serial reread of identical lines.
findings: This Windows source exports hash-many and two scalar compression functions, but lacks Unix xof_many symbol and implementation. Absence alone is not link failure: dispatcher/build platform gating must be checked separately. Unix zero-count XOF-many observation does not apply to an absent function here.

Hash-many adds RDI/RSI saves,304-byte reservation, stack64 alignment and XMM6..15 lower-half saves0x90..0x120 above counters/flags scratch. Common return restores all saved lower halves after vzeroupper and reverses general-register pushes.

Windows argument reshuffle and stacked counter/increment/flags/start/end/output offsets0x68/70/78/80/88/90 account for eight pushes. Hash-many group16/8/4/2/1 arithmetic, wider tail reads and output widths are unchanged apart from reviewed address spelling.

Scalar functions use72-byte frames preserving XMM6..9 only; native rotates eliminate higher scratch-register requirements. Both load flags at adjusted RSP+0x70, byte-extend lengthR8b, pack counterR9; XOF output from0x78 uses volatile R10. Balanced restores accompany32/64-byte output stores.
Constant tables are unchanged; section becomes .rdata. ELF GNU-stack/CET and Apple conditionals removed. No explicit unwind directives observed.
limits: 287/289 pinned blobs reviewed;150/500 complete repositories. Remaining MSVC AVX512 and xxhash.h.
No Windows/x86 assembly/runtime, caller padding, unwind or throughput proof; upstream reference-only. Deferred pHash/ASAN untouched.
